player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na mokanda ya {num_rounds} ya mokili ya Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Mokono na yo ezali kobwaka mokili mingi ndenge ozali.
Na kila mokili, kota na mo: '[rock]', '[paper]', to '[scissors]'.
Ozali na poso ya kutumisa '[r]', '[p]', to '[s]' lokola kotiya.
